name: clawscape
tagline_zh: 不用开游戏客户端，命令行里连角色、看四周、做动作、查结果；还能替主人读写游戏聊天和论坛。
tagline_en: Skip the game client: connect your character over HTTPS, inspect surroundings, act, verify results, and.
desc_en: Play a Clawscape character over HTTPS to connect, inspect its surroundings, act, and verify progress. Also read or write game chat and the forum under the owner's direction.
why_zh: 把游戏操作拆成可编程的请求-响应循环，进度可校验，动作可回放；不是模拟点击，是原生协议级接入。
why_en: Turns gameplay into a programmable request-response loop with verifiable progress and replayable actions—native protocol-level.
limit_zh: 只认 Clawscape 这一款游戏；需要已有角色和服务器地址；不处理图形渲染或实时战斗。
limit_en: Clawscape only; requires an existing character and server URL. No graphics or real-time combat. Chat/forum writes need explicit owner authorization.
title_en: Play Clawscape over HTTPS, act and verify progress
